install: if [ "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" = "Linux-x86_64" ]; then if ! command -v qemu-aarch64-static >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -f /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/qemu-aarch64 ]; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-user-static binfmt-support; fi; if ! grep -q '^enabled' /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/qemu-aarch64 2>/dev/null; then sudo sh -c 'mount -t binfmt_misc binfmt_misc /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc 2>/dev/null || true; interp=/usr/libexec/qemu-binfmt/aarch64-binfmt-P; [ -x "$interp" ] || interp=/usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static; printf ":qemu-aarch64:M::\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\x00\xb7\x00:\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\x00\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xfe\xff\xff\xff:%s:OPF\n" "$interp" > /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/register'; fi; fi
